parts.t: Neighbourhood guide · City of Chilliwack · Chilliwack Proper

Chilliwack Proper South is an MLS® sub-area name in the City of Chilliwack. The City doesn’t publish a boundary for it. The closest official description is the Chilliwack Proper and Fairfield Island Neighbourhoods Plan area, which covers the established residential area of Chilliwack Proper as a whole.

As a rough guide, the part generally called Chilliwack Proper South is the section south of Yale Road, running down toward Highway 1 around Evans Road, Hocking Avenue and Southlands Crescent. That is an orientation from the addresses of schools and parks, not a City boundary.

blocks.text: Planning and flood notes for Chilliwack Proper South

parts.t: Plans, zoning and flood rules can be different for each lot.
The Chilliwack Proper and Fairfield Island Neighbourhoods Plan covers this area. It is Schedule B2 of Official Community Plan Bylaw 2025, No. 5500, which the City adopted on December 16, 2025.

The plan was first added to the 2040 Official Community Plan as Schedule D, through Bylaw 2018, No. 4533. The City’s notice for the June 5, 2018 public hearing says its purpose is to guide future decision making on residential infill development.
ALR: Published municipal records list no ALR figure specific to Chilliwack Proper South. City-wide, 67% of Chilliwack’s land (17,322 hectares) is in the Agricultural Land Reserve.

Flood: under the City’s Floodplain Regulation Bylaw 4519, habitable floor space in areas protected by a standard dike must be at or above the applicable Flood Construction Level, plus 0.6 m of freeboard.
The City has an ongoing $30 million program to raise the dyke system to the current provincial elevation.

How do I get around from Chilliwack Proper South?
Route 52 Evans runs from the Downtown Exchange along Yale Road to the Evans Road corridor, with a timing point at Evans Rd at Yale Rd
The route 52 map names A.D. Rundle Middle School.
Route 57 Broadway runs from the Downtown Exchange along Broadway, south of Yale Road
Route 51 Vedder runs between Downtown Chilliwack and the UFV Chilliwack campus via Vedder Road, with timing points at Vedder Rd at Promontory Rd, Vedder Rd at Luckakuck Way and Yale Rd at Menzies St

Route 66 Fraser Valley Express is a regional route between Chilliwack and Lougheed Town Centre Station, via Carvolth Exchange, Highstreet Exchange and McCallum Park and Ride. Its Chilliwack stops are Downtown Chilliwack, Vedder Rd at Luckakuck Way and the Lickman Park and Ride
Which schools are near Chilliwack Proper South?
Evans Elementary (kindergarten to grade 5, 7600 Evans Rd), Robertson Elementary (kindergarten to grade 5, 46106 Southlands Cres) and A.D. Rundle Middle School (grades 6 to 8, 45660 Hocking Ave).

Chilliwack Middle School (grades 6 to 8, 46354 Yale Rd), Chilliwack Secondary School (grades 9 to 12, 46363 Yale Rd) and Imagine High (grades 9 to 12, 45669 Yale Rd) are on Yale Road, at the north edge of this area.
